title: 2011-2016 Focus / Fiesta PowerShift (DPS6): clutch shudder on light acceleration, input shaft seal leaks (programs 14M01, 19N08)
summary: Ford's DPS6 dual dry-clutch automatic can shudder or judder pulling away from a stop and during shifts. On earlier builds Ford blames transmission fluid leaking past the input shaft seals onto the clutch (14M01); on later builds, the clutch material itself (19N08). Both programs extend clutch coverage to 7 years / 100,000 miles. The fix is diagnosis with Ford's IDS shudder pinpoint test, then a new clutch (and seals on 14M01 cars), a PCM/TCM reflash and a TCM adaptive learn.
warnings: Ford's notes say the IDS service routines clear the transmission's adaptive strategy, and skipping any step of them can leave erratic shifts and driveability problems.

specs.name: 14M01 coverage (fluid-contaminated clutch, input shaft seals, software)
specs.value: 7 years or 100,000 miles from warranty start
specs.note: Builds June 6-July 8, 2013 already past the limits were covered through February 29, 2020.

specs.name: 14M01 vehicles
specs.value: 2011-2014 Fiesta (Cuautitlan, built Nov 3, 2009-Jul 8, 2013); 2012-2014 Focus (Michigan, built Aug 1, 2010-Jul 8, 2013)

specs.name: 19N08 coverage (revised clutch material)
specs.value: 7 years or 100,000 miles from warranty start; past that, through February 10, 2020

specs.name: Dual clutch kit, Fiesta
specs.value: FA6Z-7B546-B (built on or before 1/12/2011); FA6Z-7B546-A (built on or after 1/13/2011)

specs.name: Fluid
specs.value: Motorcraft dual clutch transmission fluid XT-11-QDC, up to 1 quart

specs.name: Labor: replace clutch
specs.value: 5.2 h Focus, 4.7 h Fiesta; clutch and input shaft seals 5.7 h Focus, 5.1 h Fiesta

specs.name: Minimum IDS release for the reflash

parts: Differential seal plugs F1FZ-7H183-A (Ford says to fit them whenever the transmission is out)
Engine-to-transaxle separator plate AE8Z-7007-A (1.6L Fiesta, if needed)

steps.text: With IDS, run Workshop Manual Diagnosis by Symptom, Pinpoint Test A, Clutch Shudder on Acceleration (Focus and 2014-15 Fiesta; 2011-13 Fiesta uses Pinpoint Test N). Shudder within expected limits gets a TCM adaptive learn only.
If the clutch is replaced, upload the IDS datalogger session; IDS generates a repair validation code (RVC) that Ford requires on the claim.
Replace the clutch (and on 14M01 cars, the input shaft seals) following Workshop Manual section 307-01 (2011-2013 Fiesta: 307-11), doing every step listed there.
Reflash the PCM/TCM to the latest calibration with IDS 114.04 or higher, then do the TCM adaptive learn and a road test.

body:
Ford's dealer Q&A for its TCM program says these extensions don't address the PowerShift's distinctive shift feel. They cover the module, software, clutch and seals, not how the transmission drives.

If 15B22 (the TCM reflash campaign) is open on the car, Ford's 14M01 letter says to do 15B22 first.
